title: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) by routing domain-specific data to specialized teachers, integrating their capabilities through dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, domain routing only distinguishes the supervision sources for different domains; updates from all domains still act on shared parameters. When teachers differ substantially in response style and domain expertise, supervision that is effective in isolation may still lead to persistent gradient conflicts and capability degradation during joint optimization. To address this challenge, we propose Cross-Teacher Guarding for MOPD (Road MOPD), which introduces non-routed teachers as auxiliary cross-domain critics on the same student trajectories and coordinates multi-teacher supervision through token-level credit assignment and gradient updates. translated_title: 超越域路由监督：面向多教师在线策略蒸馏的跨教师守护
translated_abstract: 多教师在线策略蒸馏扩展了在线策略蒸馏，通过将特定领域的数据路由到专门的教师模型，在学生模型生成的轨迹上通过密集的词元级监督来整合各教师模型的能力。然而，域路由只是区分了不同领域的监督来源；来自所有领域的更新仍然作用于共享参数。当教师模型在响应风格和领域专长上存在显著差异时，单独使用时有效的监督在联合优化过程中仍可能导致持续的梯度冲突和能力退化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了面向多教师在线策略蒸馏的跨教师守护方法（Road MOPD），该方法将未路由的教师模型引入为同一学生轨迹上的辅助跨域批评者，并通过词元级信用分配和梯度更新来协调多教师监督。具体而言，跨教师引导的信用分配……
tldr: 该论文提出Road MOPD方法，将未参与路由的教师模型作为辅助跨域批评者，通过词元级信用分配与梯度更新协调多教师监督，从而解决多教师在线策略蒸馏中的梯度冲突和能力退化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Road MOPD, which introduces non-routed teachers as auxiliary cross-domain critics and coordinates multi-teacher supervision via token-level credit assignment and gradient updates, mitigating gradient conflicts and capability degradation in multi-teacher on-policy distillation.
